title: Call keys in the app: publish, seal to everyone, rotate when someone leaves
spec: call_crypto::CallCrypto (no I/O): per call, a fresh X25519 call key pair and a random sender key under key id 1. step(keys, boxes) returns what to send: Publish whenever the server's key list does not show this device's key; Seal the current sender key once to every other participant whose key is known (context 'crewcraft call <call> from <sender> kid <kid>'); when anyone in the last list is gone, rotate to the next key id with a new sender key and seal again to those still there; open each box sealed to this person once (failures are not retried). The worker runs a step after each sync of the room of the call it is in, sends CallKey/CallSeal (SignedInSession::call_send, call_inputs), forgets the keys on leaving, and emits Event::CallSecurity { room, call, kid, from } when it changes (Update::CallSecurity); the window shows 'End-to-end encrypted: keys from N of M' while in the call. Three people settle to everyone holding everyone else's key and decrypting their SFrame frames; after one leaves the others send under key id 2, sealed only to each other. End to end, two real apps each receive the other's key.
